# Remove _idNNNNN Tag from Autogenerated Script Filenames Plan

## Implementation Overview
- High-level approach: Remove the product-id-based `_idN` suffix from input call names and output path predictions, relying on the PRT timestamp (monotonic per unit, ADR 0010) and `.done` markers keyed by `source_dir` for traceability.
- Key architectural decisions: `ScriptInput.String()` and `PredictOutputs` no longer append `_idN`; the tracking payload (`.processing`/`.done`) retains `unit_id`, `script_name`, and `source_dir`.
- Integration points: `internal/domain/callname/names_input.go`, `internal/domain/callname/names_output.go`, and downstream script building via `internal/domain/script/script.go`.
- Performance and scalability considerations: No performance impact; removes a string append and filename-parsing coupling.

## Task Breakdown
Organized into logical phases with atomic tasks using checkboxes. Each task is single responsibility, independently completable, verifiable, and appropriately sized.

## Testing Plan
- Unit tests: `names_input_test.go` and `names_output_test.go` assertions that check for `_idN` presence must be updated to drop `_idN` expectations and verify PRT presence.
- Integration: `script_test.go` (lines 606-609, fixture maps) asserts `_id12254` in paths/call names; update to verify PRT presence and absence of `_idN`.
- End-to-end test scenarios: `scripts/live_test.sh` resets the testing ground, runs a full pipeline pass, and prints all files in the test ground.
- Regression test considerations: Verify `.done` payload still contains `unit_id` and `script_name` (with PRT) after change; verify `findDoneFile` still resolves source->output mapping via `source_dir`.

## Dependencies & Sequencing
- Inter-task dependencies: Phase 1 (source changes) must complete before Phase 2 (test updates), because test fixtures expect the new filename format. Phase 3 (verification) depends on both Phase 1 and Phase 2.
- Critical path: names_input.go -> names_output.go -> names_input_test.go -> names_output_test.go -> script_test.go -> live_test.sh.
- External system dependencies: None; relies on existing PRT generator (monotonic counter) and `.done` marker tracking.

## Risk Mitigation
- Technical risks: Test suite assertions checking `_idN` presence will fail until updated; mitigated by comprehensive test updates in Phase 2.
- Mitigation strategies: Update all fixture maps and assertions systematically; use grep for `_id[0-9]` to catch any missed occurrences.
- Contingency plans for high-impact scenarios: If PRT uniqueness becomes a concern across process runs, rely on existing `findDoneFile` `source_dir` matching mitigation.
- Early warning indicators: `live_test.sh` output showing filenames without PRT or `.done` markers missing `unit_id`/`script_name`.
- Escalation criteria: If traceability breaks (source->output mapping fails), revert to `_idN`-based tracking and re-evaluate PRT uniqueness guarantees.

## Rollback Strategy
- Rollback points for each phase: Phase 1 changes are isolated to two functions; reverting means restoring the `_id%d` appends in names_input.go and names_output.go.
- Data migration reversal procedures: No data migration; `.done` markers and store entries are regenerated per process run.
- Feature flag configurations: None; this is a behavioral change without a toggle.
- Service deployment rollback plans: Revert the source and test commits if pipeline traceability regresses in live testing.
